content.title: Privacy Policy
content.content:
Information We Collect

We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, request a demo, or contact our support team.

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to provide, maintain, and improve the platform; process transactions; and respond to your comments and questions.

Data Security

Industry-standard encryption (AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit) with strictly controlled and audited access to customer data.

Contact Us

Contact us at privacy@forgepublicsafety.com.

content.title: Terms of Service
content.content:
Use of the Platform

Services are provided subject to these terms and any applicable order or agreement with your organization.

Agency Responsibilities

Organizations are responsible for maintaining account credentials and ensuring platform use complies with applicable laws and policies.

Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated to account administrators when possible.

content.title: Security
content.content:
Platform Security

Encrypted transport, role-based access, audit logging, and tenant isolation between platforms.

Operational Practices

Secure development practices, platform monitoring, and restricted administrative access.

Report a concern

Security questions or vulnerability reports can be sent to security@forgepublicsafety.com.
